paper: Ding et al. 2026, arXiv:2607.15197 — Emergent d-wave altermagnetism in Cl-adsorbed FeSe monolayer

open_questions.question: Is the checkerboard altermagnetic order actually the ground state at 0.25 hole/Fe, or merely a low-lying metastable configuration?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The paper's own discussion warns that imposing a checkerboard config and observing splitting does NOT prove it is the true ground state. Only a full 8-configuration total-energy comparison (which our TB surrogate cannot do) settles this.
open_questions.next_step: Run spin-polarized DFT (or a Heisenberg-plus-doping model) enumerating all 8 magnetic configs vs. doping to confirm the dimer->checkerboard transition and its critical doping.

open_questions.question: What sets the absolute 620 meV scale microscopically — is delta (ligand hopping anisotropy) really ~0.09 eV for Cl on FeSe?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Our surrogate reproduces 620-720 meV only after tuning delta; the value is not derived from first principles. The magnitude claim rests on the true Cl-induced anisotropy.
open_questions.next_step: Wannier-downfold the DFT bands of Fe2Se2Cl to extract the real Fe-Fe hopping anisotropy and on-site exchange, then feed them into this TB model unmodified.

open_questions.question: How does SOC modify the splitting and open the reported anti-crossings (Weyl gapping along X-M vs M-Y)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The paper reports Neel-vector-dependent Weyl gapping ([100] vs [110]) that our spin-conserving no-SOC model cannot capture, but which is central to the spintronic/topological pitch.
open_questions.next_step: Add a Rashba/atomic SOC term lambda (L.S) to the 4x4 (spinful, 2-sublattice) Hamiltonian and track anti-crossing gaps vs Neel-vector orientation.

open_questions.question: Does the altermagnetism truly survive in the 10-layer slab / bulk limit as claimed?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The robustness-to-bulk claim is a key novelty (surface-driven, decoupled from nonmagnetic bulk). A 2D monolayer TB cannot test interlayer hybridization.
open_questions.next_step: Extend the TB model to a multilayer stack with interlayer hopping t_perp and a nonmagnetic underlayer; check whether the top-layer d-wave splitting persists.

open_questions.question: Would the lifted spin degeneracy actually bias equal-spin triplet pairing as the paper speculates?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The headline application (Majorana / topological quantum computing) hinges on triplet SC emerging from the altermagnetic normal state.
open_questions.next_step: Add an attractive interaction to the TB model and solve the linearized gap equation to see whether Delta_up-up / Delta_dn-dn channels are favored over singlet.

next_steps: Wannier-downfold real DFT hoppings to remove the delta-tuning and make the 620 meV a prediction rather than a fit.
Enumerate all 8 magnetic configurations vs doping to prove checkerboard is the ground state.
Add SOC (4x4 spinful) to reproduce Neel-vector-dependent Weyl anti-crossings.
Multilayer/slab extension to test bulk-limit robustness.
Linearized gap equation for triplet-pairing susceptibility.
